purpose: Hugo is a fast static site generator written in Go for building websites, blogs, and documentation.
Midday is a business management platform for freelancers offering invoicing, time tracking, file reconciliation, and financial overview with an AI assistant.
Cap is an open-source screen recording tool built with Tauri/Rust as a Loom alternative for creating shareable recordings.
Scrapling is an adaptive Python web scraping framework supporting single requests to full-scale crawls with AI-powered extraction and MCP server integration.
Shodan-Dorks is an auto-updating collection of Shodan search queries (dorks) for discovering exposed IoT devices and services.
Master-OSINT-Toolkit is a Python toolkit providing OSINT features like image geolocation, social media profiling, email breach checks, and metadata extraction.
WP-Site-Inspector-Agent is a WordPress debugging and discovery tool that uses AI to analyze shortcodes, hooks, templates, REST APIs, and logs.
GoForDorks simplifies the use of advanced search engine operators (dorks) across Google, Yandex, DuckDuckGo, and other search engines.
